title: Ferromagnetically coupled tetranuclear Ni(II)-2-oxy-aceto- or benzo-phenonate complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4250-4261
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08700C, Paper

Imdadul Haque, Mohammed Enamullah, Nisat Taslum Jhumur, Baldeep K. Sidhu, David E. Herbert, Takin Haj Hassani Sohi, Lubomír Havlíček, Ivan Nemec, Christoph Janiak
Reaction of 2-hydroxy-acetophenone/benzophenone (HL/HL′) with nickel(II) acetate provides ferromagnetically coupled tetranuclear [Ni(L)(μ3-CH3O)(CH3OH)]4 (1) or [Ni(L′)(μ3-CH3O)(H2O)]4·H2O (2) complexes.
